items.title: LAPTOP Token Implosion
points: Hunter Biden's LAPTOP meme coin (a cryptocurrency created mainly for hype/humor rather than utility) launched Wednesday on the Base blockchain and hit a peak of $190.81 before crashing roughly 99%.
Thin liquidity (limited buy/sell order depth, making prices swing wildly under selling pressure) allowed a wave of selling to crater the price.

Biden claimed critics had 'PTSD' from prior political meme coin flops but admitted LAPTOP's tokenomics (rules governing how and when tokens are released or unlocked) unfold over months rather than instantly, unlike predecessors.
The collapse echoes earlier failures of the TRUMP and MELANIA tokens, suggesting celebrity-backed meme coins consistently struggle with launch liquidity.

items.title: ConsenSys Restructuring
points: ConsenSys Software Inc. will fully rebrand as MetaMask, its flagship and highest-revenue wallet product.
A newly formed ConsenSys entity will take over Ethereum protocol development and related infrastructure work.
The split separates the profitable consumer wallet business from lower-margin protocol development.

items.title: Block's Bank Charter Application
points: Jack Dorsey's Block is applying for a bank charter to consolidate its Bitcoin custody operations.
The company currently manages custody under more than 50 separate state money transmitter licenses.
A bank charter would unify regulatory oversight and cut compliance overhead across jurisdictions.

items.title: Liquid Hack Recovery Efforts
points: Blockstream is negotiating to recover 598.5 Bitcoin (about $47 million) still missing from a $320 million exploit of its Liquid sidechain (a Bitcoin-linked side network for faster, more private transactions).
The firm is dealing directly with 'white hats' (ethical hackers willing to return funds) rather than relying solely on legal or law enforcement action.
The talks suggest attackers may be open to returning part of the stolen funds instead of cashing out entirely.

items.title: Germany's Crypto Tax Plan
points: Germany is drafting a 25% tax on crypto gains set to take effect in 2027.
Assets purchased before the effective date would retain a twelve-month tax exemption window.

sections.title: LAPTOP Token Implosion
points: 1. The token launched Wednesday on Base blockchain and immediately pumped to $190.81 before shedding roughly 99% of its value as sellers overwhelmed limited available liquidity.

2. Biden argued detractors had 'PTSD' from previous political meme coin failures but acknowledged LAPTOP has tokenomics (release mechanisms) unfolding over months rather than hours, giving it structural advantages those predecessors lacked.
3. The collapse mirrors failures of TRUMP and MELANIA tokens, suggesting celebrity-backed meme coins face severe liquidity constraints at launch.

sections.title: ConsenSys Restructuring
points: 1. ConsenSys Software Inc. will rebrand entirely as MetaMask, the wallet product that generates most revenue.
2. A newly formed ConsenSys entity will assume control of Ethereum protocol development and related infrastructure work.
3. The split separates the high-revenue consumer wallet business from lower-margin protocol development operations.

sections.title: Block's Bank Charter Application
points: 1. Jack Dorsey's Block is seeking a bank charter specifically to consolidate Bitcoin custody services currently operated under fragmented state licenses.
2. Block currently holds more than 50 state money transmitter licenses for various custody operations.
3. A bank charter would create a unified regulatory structure and reduce compliance overhead across jurisdictions.

sections.title: Liquid Hack Recovery Efforts
points: 1. Blockstream is in negotiations to recover 598.5 Bitcoin (approximately $47 million) remaining from a $320 million exploit of the Liquid sidechain.
2. The company is engaging with 'white hats' (ethical hackers) rather than pursuing purely legal or law enforcement channels.
